title: Austin Vote Canvass: Nofziger, Shipman, Humphrey Win
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to officially confirm the results of the May 2, 1987 run-off election.
*   Michael "Max" Nofziger was declared the winner for City Council Place 1.
*   Sally Shipman secured her victory for City Council Place 3.
*   George Humphrey was confirmed as the winner for City Council Place 4.
*   The short meeting was dedicated exclusively to formally validating the election votes.
